{{Top}}
A '''sleeper ship''' was an interstellar [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] capable of achieving faster than light travel, via rudimentary [[dimensional drive]] technology, while its inhabitants were kept in a state of [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Typical speeds made travel between distant [[Star/Legends|stars]] last decades or centuries, well beyond a normal [[Human/Legends|Human]] lifespan.

==History==
Up to that time, [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] used [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ships]]. They learned the technology to construct sleeper [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from their [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] overlords while [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was a part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] circa [[30,000 BBY]]. The technology was made feasible with the discovery of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] ore in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]].<ref name="TEA" />

When the Empire fell, the sleeper ships contributed to the colonization of other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before the invention of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] technology. The [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] was settled by Humans from Coruscant with this technology, as were the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Janilis VII]], [[Barseg]], and those of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], and even [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

A different type of sleeper ship was constructed by the [[Settled Worlds]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] during their pre-Republic isolation, and launched from the planet [[Furies Gate]]. These ships attempted to reach the rest of the galaxy, but were not heard from once they left.<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>
